title: "Model Edit tools"

<!-- Generated by src/CommaTs/docs/site/scripts/convert-guide.mjs from src/CommaTs/docs/PluginGuide.html. Do not edit. -->

Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit, and the two-row **Model Edit** group on the Comma ribbon tab. Twelve tools that edit the geometry of existing objects. They share one rhythm: set the options in the dialog, click **Apply**, pick a reference, then pick the targets (or preselect them before you click Apply); the command repeats until <kbd>Esc</kbd>. Gap fields accept arithmetic such as (2+3)\*4 and imperial feet/inch fractions, according to XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
Each change is a native Tekla modify: if an error stops a run, earlier changes can remain, so inspect the model and use **Undo** before retrying. These tools are new in this release: try them on a copy of your model first.
{{% /callout %}}
